# The subset of the vendored xurdif engine's requirements that Kiln actually
# needs. Kiln installs THIS file, not requirements.txt next to it, so users do
# not pay for the standalone gradio reference apps (gradio pulls fastapi,
# uvicorn, pandas and more -- several hundred MB Kiln never imports).
#
# requirements.txt next to this file is Kiln-authored: upstream ships no
# requirements file at all, only a prose list in its README. It stays because it
# is still the accurate dependency list for the vendored modules, including the
# gradio reference apps. If you re-vendor a newer xurdif, diff what
# xurdif.py / xurdiftrainer.py / postproc*.py import against this file and add
# anything new.
#
# torch/torchvision are unpinned on purpose: an already-installed CUDA build
# must be left alone, and pip will NOT downgrade it to a CPU wheel.
torch>=2.0
torchvision>=0.15

# --- core training + sampling ---
pytorch-msssim>=1.0      # SSIM loss (xurdif.py)
lpips>=0.1.4             # perceptual loss (xurdiftrainer.py, xurdif.py)
einops>=0.7              # tensor rearrange (xurdif.py)
numpy>=1.24
Pillow>=10.0
tqdm>=4.66

# --- DDIM sampling, CLIP guidance, post-processing ---
diffusers>=0.27         # DDIMScheduler
kornia>=0.7             # enhance/filters used by postproc
opencv-python>=4.8      # cv2 post-processing
ftfy                    # CLIP tokenizer dependency
regex                   # CLIP tokenizer dependency

# NOTE: `clip` itself comes from the root requirements.txt, which pins a commit.
